newsitem.title: USA: Transitional Hospitals subject of probe.
newsitem.headline: Transitional Hospitals subject of probe.

text.p: Transitional Hospitals Corp said late Friday that it is a target of a grand jury investigation arising from activities of the company's formerly owned dialysis business.

The investigation, said the company, involves purported Medicare fraud involving certain laboratory tests performed by a partnership which existed from June 1987 to June 1992 between privately-held Damon Corp and the company.
Transitional Hospitals spun off its dialysis business, now called Vivra Inc, on September 1, 1989.
Transitional said in a statement it is cooperating fully in the investigation.
